content: Python scheduling ecosystem treats recurrence (RRULE, via dateutil.rrule) as an orthogonal concern layered on top of resource/capacity scheduling, not fused into one library. Resource-capacity constraint solvers (e.g. pyschedule) handle capacity bounds on concurrent task/resource assignment separately from calendar recurrence expansion. This confirms recurrence is reasonably deferred/decoupled from the core resource+capacity+hold engine.
